hero.subheadline: A full-day hackathon on well-being and inclusion in computing
hero.valueProposition: Build tech solutions around well-being and support for women in computing at Sophia Antipolis, France, on 30 September 2026. Open to all genders aged 18 and above.

content.whyJoin:
The womENcourage hackathon runs on the opening day of the ACM Celebration of Women in Computing, showcasing how computer science can drive well-being. You work in teams through ideation, solution development, a slide deck, and a final pitch before judges.

It is open to all genders, nationalities, and backgrounds, and no prior IT experience is required - interest in technology is the key requirement. Beginners and experienced developers build side by side, and multidisciplinary teams are encouraged.

Hackathon access is included in conference registration, which also opens keynotes, workshops, the Career Fair, poster sessions, and panels.
content.whoShouldApply:
This is for students, professionals, and enthusiasts who want to build technology in a women-in-computing-focused environment. You should enjoy using technology, teamwork, and communication to solve real problems.

You must be at least 18 years old and able to attend in person in Sophia Antipolis, France.
benefits: Full-day hands-on hackathon from ideation to pitch
Teamwork with an international, multidisciplinary community
Access to the womENcourage Career Fair, workshops, and poster sessions
tips: Register for the conference and select the hackathon before the late registration deadline
Choose a challenge aligned with support and inclusion in computing
Be ready to build as a team - open to programmers and non-programmers alike
Apply early for a womENcourage scholarship if you need help with registration
Review the hackathon schedule so you can go from idea to pitch on the day

shouldYouApply.idealFor: This is ideal for a student, early-career professional, or enthusiast aged 18 and above who wants a hands-on, team-based project challenge within a global celebration of women in computing.
goodFit: A computer science or engineering student wanting team experience

notIdealFor: Anyone who cannot attend in person on 30 September 2026

faq.question: Who can join the hackathon?
faq.answer: Participants of all genders, nationalities, and backgrounds aged 18 and above. Prior IT experience is not mandatory - interest in technology is the key requirement.

faq.question: What is the theme?
faq.answer: The 2026 theme is 'Unmute Yourself, Grow Stronger Together: Wellbeing and Support for Women in Computing'. Teams create technology solutions that support well-being and inclusion.

faq.question: When is the hackathon?
faq.answer: Hackathon day is 30 September 2026, as part of the conference running 30 September - 2 October 2026 in Sophia Antipolis, France.

faq.question: How do I register?
faq.answer: Register through the general conference registration form and then select the hackathon in the form provided. Scholarships can cover registration for selected students and early-career professionals.

submissionGuide.detail: Complete general conference registration, which includes hackathon access, before the late registration deadline.
